context:
Goal: a lane never stalls on a permission popup nobody answers (your ruling R13).
Problem (rule): R13 point 2 asked lanes to start in a mode where an act not pre-allowed is refused, not asked, and said a builder first confirms the cloud `dontAsk` mode refuses. The lane measured: a headless dontAsk refused a write, but the default control also refused (no one to ask), so refuse-versus-ask in a cloud lane is unmeasured. `create_session` with permission_mode dontAsk is refused ("exceeds parent session's auto") because the coordinator runs auto. The installed allow list (17 entries) has no Bash, Edit or Write, so dontAsk lanes could not work, and a guard that requires dontAsk would block every lane start.
Based on (measured): lane lane-cards' probes, via the coordinator 16:57 CST Nov 13; unchecked by the coordinator and by triage. Past ruling: R13 point 2 (owner 16:16 CST Nov 10), which option b follows and option a departs from.
Departs from: R13 point 2 (lanes in a refuse-not-ask mode) — option a keeps lanes in auto with the box and card guards (PRs #3236 and #3283); option b runs the coordinator in dontAsk.
Meanwhile: lanes keep running in auto with the guards. PR #3283 (head 105c3d29691cec2cdcd108dcc379727f80713d1f) is stacked on #3236, so #3236 merges first.
